meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Benchling 平台上的实验室数据录入与查询
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的实验室用 Benchling 管理研发数据,想自动同步和查询。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data entry and queries on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your lab uses Benchling and needs automated data entry and lookup.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 Benchling 的 Python SDK 和 REST API 操作实验室数据:创建和登记 DNA/RNA/AA 序列与实体、管理库存样本和容器、写电子实验记录条目、跑工作流任务、查数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化 Benchling 数据时接管,比如管理序列与实体、库存样本、ELN 记录等。前提是配好租户 URL 和 API key 或 OAuth 凭据。

say.text: 用 benchling-sdk 建一个环形质粒序列,名字叫 My Plasmid
say.note: 会调用 dna_sequences.create 创建实体

say.text: 把 cont_abc123 这个容器转移到 Freezer Box A1
say.note: 会调用 containers.transfer 做位置转移

say.text: 帮我确认一下当前 Benchling 账号是谁
say.note: 调用 users.get_me 验证凭据是否可用

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude work with Benchling through the Python SDK and REST API: create and register DNA/RNA/AA sequences and entities, manage inventory samples and containers, write ELN entries, run workflow tasks, and query the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Use it when automating Benchling lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API, e.g. managing sequences and entities, inventory samples, or ELN entries. Requires a tenant URL plus an API key or OAuth credentials.

say_en.text: Create a circular plasmid DNA sequence named My Plasmid with benchling-sdk
say_en.note: Calls dna_sequences.create to make the entity
